definitions: A pungent yellow or brown paste made from ground mustard seeds, typically eaten with meat or other savoury food.
A plant of the cabbage family with yellow flowers and seeds that are used as a spice or in making mustard.
A dull yellow colour, like that of mustard.
examples: Do you want mustard with your hot dog?
Mustard plants are grown for their seeds.
The wall was painted a mustard colour.
